simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to חָשַׁשׁ (H2842) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: חָשַׁשׁ (châshash) means dry grass First listed occurrence: Isa 5 24.

definitions.full: H2842. chashash חֲשַׁשׁ noun masculine Isaiah 59:24 chaff ; — absolute קַשׁ ח ׳תַּהֲרוּ תֵלְדוּ Isa 33:11 ye conceive chaff, ye bring forth stubble (figurative of vain attempt of Assyr.); construct יִרְמֶּה ׳ח לֶהָבָה 5:24 (|| קַשׁ ) as flaming chaff sinketh down (simile of perishing of heedless Judahites). חֻשָׁתִי see חושׁ . חִתָּה חַת, see חתת .
